# Social image resizer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/social-resizer/

Place a photo into a square, portrait, story, landscape or thumbnail canvas. Fill the frame with a crop or fit the entire image on a colored background.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Prepare the same photo as a 1080 × 1080 square and a 1080 × 1920 vertical canvas.

## Limits and checks

These are convenient canvas sizes, not a guarantee of every platform’s current requirements. Important content should stay away from interface overlays.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
